summary: Globus Maritime filed a Form 6-K disclosing delivery of the M/V Glbs Thalia, a 2026-built ~64,000 DWT Ultramax dry bulk carrier constructed at Nihon Shipyard in Japan, an acquisition previously announced August 23, 2023. No price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. The fleet rises to eleven vessels totaling roughly 808,622 DWT; the release text inconsistently describes ten owned operating vessels. This is an ordinary fleet-renewal operational update, not a special situation; watch fleet-value and charter-rate disclosure rather than any deal terms.
